name: Image Compressor
description: Lossless PNG + high-quality JPEG compression, powered by sharp (Apple Silicon native). Outputs to a sibling 'compressed/' folder, preserves filenames + format. Picks up Finder selection automatically.
author: Coco

subtitle.en: PNG lossless + JPEG · sharp (Apple Silicon native) · uses Finder selection
subtitle.zh: PNG 无损 + JPEG 高质量 · sharp 原生 · 自动读取访达选中

preferences.title: Compression effort
preferences.description: Higher = smaller files, slower on large images. For JPEG it nudges quality (85 → 80 → 72); for PNG it raises sharp's lossless effort.

preferences.title: Strip metadata
preferences.description: Remove EXIF/profile data. Smaller files, no visual difference.
